content.characters: Nova, Sera, Rin, Miu and Kai use the current game's front/portrait assets. Roles and relationships are based on campaign.opening and stage dialogue. No actor names or numeric ages added.
content.world: Seven opening events only. 20XX is the sole stated era. The other labels are ordering numbers, not invented calendar years. No endings or character deaths disclosed.
content.mini_games: Breakout, pinball, slots and bingo verified in current native/arcade.gd and Notion. The retired mobile runner is not promoted.
content.site_dialogue: Nova and Sera's guide dialogue is newly written for the website, not a quotation of recorded in-game dialogue.
content.privacy: Existing disclosures, including older-version Firebase, retained in native details. Short summary and compact consent banner added. Analytics implementation and consent logic unchanged. Contact wording links directly to the existing X destination rather than describing the footer.
content.badges: Existing common/appstore_badge.svg, common/Google_Play_Badge_JA.svg and common/Google_Play_Badge_EN.png reused without redrawing.
content.chibi_art: New website illustration based on verified Nova and Sera front art: Nova reminds Sera to guide visitors while he plays. Transparent PNG, 1536x1024. Original game portraits retained for the cast and story.
content.navigation: One accessible mini-game tab set replaces the four stacked explanations. Direct links, language switching, Arrow keys and Home/End preserve selection. Back-to-top returns focus to the header and stays hidden while consent controls are open. The top control uses an angular blue panel with gold chevrons, replacing the generic round arrow.
content.enemy_catalog: Stage 1 only: drone, white-rider, fighter, elder, Pursuer Hound (midboss) and Collector Veil (boss). Identical appearance roster verified in campaign encounters for easy, normal and hard. No later-stage profiles or artwork included. New character traits and salary settings are distinguished from canonical roles and specifications.
content.art_format: Four generated regular-enemy illustrations converted losslessly from PNG to WebP; two original in-game boss illustrations reused unchanged. Only the selected illustration is requested. All 26 produced illustrations preserved outside the website repository.

measurement.primary: Consented store_click sessions divided by consented home-page sessions; clicks are not installs.
measurement.events: Existing store_click parameters store, placement, site_language, game_id and page_path unchanged.
measurement.qa: Local browser QA does not load the production analytics tag. No production store clicks were generated by this update.
